entries.body:
# Material Buildroot 0.1.0

**Classic Har Gow · 蝦餃**

The first downloadable Windows x64 desktop milestone provides a real empty workspace, durable English/Hong Kong Cantonese/bilingual language settings, session-only appearance controls, window controls and visible build provenance.

## Download and install

Download **Setup.exe** for the genuine unsigned Squirrel.Windows installer. This release also includes `RELEASES`, the full `.nupkg`, SHA-256 checksums and source-bound provenance. This is the first package, so no delta package is expected.

The installer is unsigned and may trigger an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning. Automatic updates are not implemented. Native installation and update verification are separate from package production and are not claimed by the package manifest.

## What is implemented

- Sandboxed, context-isolated desktop shell with narrowly validated host operations.
- Durable language settings through the capability-bound broker and SQLite store.
- Real minimize, maximize/restore and close controls.
- Honest empty-project and preserved-invalid-storage states.
- Original product icon, build version, source and update-time provenance.

Project creation, actual Buildroot execution, WSL/container adapters, VM workflows, encrypted publication, the companion and the wider required-feature roadmap remain unfinished. This normal release classification does not claim a complete Buildroot management product.

## Verification boundaries

The desktop behavior was verified against source `3f5d2cd5bbdafbeda324514c3db0da9f0328bcfd`: 48 settings tuples, 52 validated layout receipts, all three languages surviving real process restarts, six additional keyboard/accessibility combinations, real reload/stale-revision recovery, event replay deduplication, and two preserved invalid/foreign storage fixtures. The release source adds packaging and icon wiring; earlier GUI captures retain their original source identity.

The earlier source suite passed 61 tests; later documentation admission repairs passed five targeted tests. These are separate runs. Browser/runtime scale factors do not prove independent native operating-system DPI settings. Five website verification profiles and the strict cleanup audit remain intentionally skipped and incomplete. No installer update pair or fresh-host acceptance is claimed.

Release source: `0881a3a3f58c85bf73f57035b3a09da3acbbe1a8`.

### Installed-launch result

The installer was exercised on the selected current Windows host. The installed executable and `app.asar` exactly matched the full package, and the installed shell launched at version 0.1.0/source `0881a3a3f58c85bf73f57035b3a09da3acbbe1a8`, with ready storage and bilingual presentation. A genuine installed-window capture was inspected. Setup and the installed executable report `NotSigned`.

Setup exited before the lifecycle helper retained its exit-code receipt, so that exit code is unavailable. No independent signer-process audit, update pair, fresh-host, cancellation or uninstall proof is claimed. All verification-owned processes, desktops and ports were closed; the installation and profiles were retained.

The automatic publication workflow [38682722692](https://github.com/Ding-Ding-Projects/material-buildroot/actions/runs/38682722692) also completed successfully and produced a separate normal automated build. That pipeline builds and packages without tests or lint; this manually verified download retains its own exact asset hashes.

[Desktop evidence and screenshots](https://ding-ding-projects.github.io/material-buildroot/site/articles/docs/evidence/desktop-shell/README.html) · [Roadmap](https://ding-ding-projects.github.io/material-buildroot/site/roadmap.html) · [Public dish photo](https://github.com/Ding-Ding-Projects/dim-sum-photos/releases/download/catalog-v1/hk-dish-0001-classic-har-gow.png).

The dish name is from public catalog revision `7e180e19f9a117ea38e30955e8ff111a870bdfa2`, record `hk-dish-0001`. The photo remains in its owning catalog release; no duplicate is attached.

## 廣東話

首個可下載的 Windows x64 桌面版本已提供真實空白工作區、可儲存的英文／廣東話／雙語設定、視窗操作及版本資料。下載 `Setup.exe` 安裝。安裝程式未簽署，可能出現不明發行者或 SmartScreen 提示。

今次係桌面介面的首個有限里程碑，未有建立項目、執行 Buildroot、自動更新或完整產品功能。驗證範圍同未完成工作已逐項列明，唔會將有安裝檔當成全部功能完成。
